steps.level: The battle runs itself. Save up gold 💰 and tap ▲ under the battle to level your hero up. Hold the button to repeat.
steps.stay: Stay keeps the party on this floor: gold keeps coming but you do not advance. Use it when a floor is hard and build strength.
steps.village: The Village tab: spend floor points ⭐ on barracks upgrades for more and stronger creeps.
steps.quests: Quests: daily tasks and achievements give rewards. A red dot means a reward is waiting.
steps.pet: The floor-10 boss drops a pet egg. Tap a hero portrait in the Heroes tab: the card lets you feed the pet, which boosts stats.
steps.prestige: Rebirth resets the floor and hero levels but grants ancestor crystals 🔮 that permanently boost attack and gold. The button is on the Battle tab.
